props.name: value
props.description: The tag's text and the only required prop. Keep it short, since long text truncates and shows in a native tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: With value, renders a key/value pair as one split tag: label on the left, value on the right. In split mode title, iconProps and DOM attributes (id, data-*, aria-*) are dropped. Compose two Tags yourself if you need them.

props.name: theme
props.description: Decorative colour name, not a status. Pass the colour, never success, danger, warning or error, which don't compile.

values.name: green
values.whenToNotUse: A stable attribute. It looks identical to a success state.

values.name: red
values.whenToNotUse: A stable attribute. It looks identical to a failure state.

values.name: yellow
values.whenToNotUse: A stable attribute. It looks identical to a warning.

props.name: icon
props.description: An IconV2 name shown before the text.

props.name: iconProps
props.description: Extra props passed to the icon, except name, size, fallback and ref. Dropped in split mode.

props.name: actionIcon
props.description: An IconV2 name for a dismiss or remove button after the text. Use it with onActionClick.

props.name: onActionClick
props.description: Fires when the action icon is clicked. It stops propagation, so the tag's onClick doesn't also fire.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. The tag renders a div with no role or tabIndex, so keyboard and screen reader users can't reach it. Use Button when the tag must be activated.

props.name: enableHover
props.description: Applies hover styling to a non-clickable tag. Overwritten in split mode.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Renders a full pill shape instead of the default corner radius.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Visual state only. It sets no aria-disabled and doesn't stop onClick, so stop passing the handler instead.

props.name: title
props.description: Native tooltip. Falls back to value then label, so don't pass an empty string. Dropped in split mode.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. On a split tag it applies to the wrapper.

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Classes for the left half of a split tag.

props.name: valueClassName
props.description: Classes for the right half of a split tag.
